# ACHR News

> > Weekly newsmagazine covering the HVACR industry for residential and commercial contractors, featuring equipment news, industry trends, and regulatory updates.

ACHR News serves as the primary trade publication for heating, ventilation, air conditioning, and refrigeration professionals. The publication covers major industry events like AHR Expo, regulatory changes including tax credits and energy efficiency standards, workforce development, and technological innovations in HVAC equipment and systems.

## Key Topics

- HVACR Industry
- AHR Expo
- Energy Efficiency
- HVAC Equipment
- Tax Credits (25C)
- Nexstar Network
- Contractor News
- ECM Motors
- Industry Organizations (HRAI, IOR)
- Workforce Development
- Natural Refrigerants
- Professional Associations
- Trade Shows and Conferences
- HVAC Technology Innovation
